scheme_name: Marriage Assistance To Daughters Of Prisoners
other_conditions: Either the father or the mother must be undergoing imprisonment for more than two years.
The applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala State.
The application must be submitted after six months of marriage and within one year period.
A maximum of two daughters from a family can receive financial assistance.
If the marriage grant has been sanctioned and the marriage is later dissolved or remarried, the grant becomes ineligible.
benefits_summary: Maximum financial assistance of ₹30,000 per daughter for marriage.
